About EIG

Not a generic consultancy.
A collective of proven leaders.

Ecosystem Intelligence Group is a sector-led intelligence and delivery platform. Each expert within EIG is a recognised leader in their field — not an account manager, not a generalist. Real accountability. Real authority. Real delivery.

EIG sits within the Sib Consulting FZCO family alongside TeamSIB, the architecture and execution practice. Where TeamSIB designs and delivers, EIG provides the intelligence layer — the strategic understanding of how value moves across interconnected systems, markets, and disciplines.

This is what separates EIG: sector-led. owner-led. cross-disciplinary. intelligence to execution.

We do not measure success by deliverables produced or hours billed. We measure it by the value created.

"Strategy is easy. Delivery is where value is won. We measure what we promise, and we stay until delivery is real."
